checks.name: duplicate_target_key:dim_date
checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT dim_date.SK_DateID) AS dup_cnt FROM atlas.dwd.dim_date AS dim_date WHERE dim_date.SK_DateID IN (SELECT fact_trades.SK_CreateDateID FROM atlas.dwd.fact_trades AS fact_trades INNER JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_date AS dim_date ON fact_trades.SK_CreateDateID = dim_date.SK_DateID WHERE dim_date.DateValue BETWEEN CAST('2012-07-07' AS DATE) AND CAST('2017-07-07' AS DATE)) LIMIT 1
